title: No Star Pollution
prompt: Implement count_vowels(text) in a way that only defines the function and the constant VOWELS at module level. The grader checks that importing your code does NOT define the common name 'temp' — i.e., don't leak work variables to module scope.

tests.name: counts vowels
tests.hint: Sum 1 for each char in VOWELS.

tests.name: no leaked work variables
tests.code: assert 'temp' not in dir() and 'result' not in dir()
tests.hint: Keep loop variables inside the function — module scope holds only VOWELS and count_vowels.
